verdict.rationale: Blink Shell documents its own secure remote access: SSH and Mosh with Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA keys, plus tunnels (-L), proxycommand and ssh-agent. That covers reaching remote servers wherever they run. Nothing in the evidence mentions Kubernetes or any infrastructure-access layer beyond plain SSH/Mosh, so a central part of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: Kubernetes cluster access, broader infrastructure-access features (identity-based or brokered access to diverse resources), independent corroboration of secure-access depth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get secure infrastructure access to resources wherever they live, including Kubernetes clusters

citations.quote: Supports Ed25519, ECDSA and RSA keys... Including _tunnels_ (-L), _proxycommand_ and _ssh-agent_.
Keys: Create SSH key pairs for a more secure, password-less access to your servers.
In Blink type ssh [user@]hostname. For example : ssh irwin@irwinvb.
In Blink type mosh [user@]hostname. For example : mosh irwin@irwinvb.
